0022600132.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-2) host the Miami Heat (0-4) in Atlanta's fifth game of the season. The Hawks are 7th in the East and 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back, with a 0-1 home record, while the Heat are 15th in the East and have lost four straight. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Miami's Pelle Larsson (ankle sprain) and Simone Fontecchio (illness) are both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Heat beat the Hawks 143-117 in Miami on April 12, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series in which the Hawks lost 1-3.
